replacement.sketch: No resource change required: the shared en-US adapter computes DateTime values; tests do not mutate adapter locale/formats or acquire layers, timers or native handles. Preserve invalid MUI date semantics.
No resource change required: country lookup, phone draft conversion and color normalization are value helpers. No browser form, phone service, country API or filesystem is acquired.
No resource change required: three synthetic ReactContextInvariantError instances are compared as values; no React provider tree or service lifetime is created.

No resource change required: renderToStaticMarkup creates no mounted browser lifetime. The viewer slices supplied UTF-16 offsets; native FileSystem/MemoryFS are irrelevant. Static rendering does not prove callback-ref scrolling or browser cleanup.

No resource change required: these tests call pure exports and NumberInputTestKit directly; they do not mount useNumberInput/useMobile, acquire Atom registries or attach DOM listeners. No hook lifecycle proof is claimed.
No resource change required: all seven generated UI schemas are in-memory values and codecs. Notification/toast models are not delivered to a UI event service; no provider or logger is installed.

No resource change required: the theme is a fixed plain object and style functions return overrides; no ThemeProvider, DOM or external service is acquired. The empty applyStyles stub is not dark-mode coverage.
No resource change required: resolveThemeMode receives explicit mode/preference arguments; these tests mount no provider and own no localStorage or media-query subscription.
No resource change required: chart/input/textarea renderToStaticMarkup and cn are synchronous SSR subjects. No mounted subscriptions or native resources require a Layer; MemoryFS does not apply.
No resource change required: href strings are inspected as data; no navigation, HTTP request, browser or filesystem access occurs. Active-protocol fixtures must remain inert.
